correctness.rationale: For primes p>=11, w_p=log(1+p^-3) obeys w_p<=sum_{q>p}w_q: five explicit successor-prime rational inequalities cover 11,13,17,19,23, and Nagura p_next<6p/5 for p>=29 bounds all later tails. The complete-subsums lemma then makes the closure of finite tail products exactly [1,P]. For small primes 2,3,5,7 the cutoff exponent buckets (4,2,2,2) all overlap [1,P], giving exactly 4*2*2*2=32 closed candidate intervals with rational lower factors and upper factors times P. Independent exact Fraction merging with rigorous P_1000<=P<=P_1000/(1-1/(2*1000^2)) produced 14 disjoint maximal components and the full published endpoint-code list, checking every gap strictly.
